submission.reasoning: The activity is consistent with a brief local firewall configuration test, rather than an attack. On workstation5, WORKSTATION5\wardog used the Windows System32 netsh.exe to add an inbound TCP 450 rule named "remote support" at 04:19:04.410 UTC. The same cmd.exe parent launched netsh to delete that exact rule at 04:19:09.027, approximately 4.6 seconds later, under the same account. Nearby process activity showed only these commands and the Windows Group Policy service; the reviewed evidence showed no associated remote-access payload or persistence.
